citations.assessment: Rashi gives the rose explanation and favors the place reading.
Rashi gives both the rose and place readings, and points to the praise and rebuke in Gittin.
The appellation is linked to inhabitants of Vardina; Rashi comments on stinginess.
The exact beauty/teaching wordplay is Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak’s; the preceding statement is Ammi in Yochanan’s name.
Ammi Vardinaah does not examine the animal on the festival. Rabbi Ammi approves, and the Gemara distinguishes his own earlier examination.
